budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Deliver personal cargo through a two-route corridor while deciding whether to trust claims, spend fuel on escort/aid, and honour costly commitments.
task.natural_termination: All agents have delivered or wrecked; otherwise truncate at 64 raw steps. Delivered and wrecked roles are inactive with wait as their only legal action.
task.interaction: Another controlled vehicle guarding next to a dangerous crossing converts a damaging bounced entry into real passage; fuel gifts, finite shared depots, public signals and verified or broken commitment histories change subsequent feasible choices.
task.observation_access: Public topology, vehicle telemetry, destinations, messages and actual interaction histories. Scout agent 0 knows both danger bits at reset; other roles learn a crossing only within Manhattan distance one and retain that knowledge. Observe returns only the observing role knowledge mask and danger bits, unknown=-1. Hidden danger is never in a movement mask or public map. Public damage and audited claims can support inference beyond direct sightings. Static landmark positions are known.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Per-step dangerous entries protected by another controlled agent.
Per-step signed fuel transfer amount for each agent; over-cap excess is spilled.
Per-step delivery flags, in agent order.
Cumulative commitments fulfilled through actual protected peer crossings.
Cumulative unresolved commitments whose deadline expired.
Cumulative checked safe-route claims that matched actual route safety.
Cumulative checked safe-route claims contradicted by actual route danger.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
